clue.text: Having risen, clothed oneself? In one's best, seemingly!

definitions.meaning: taken literally, someone who has got up out of bed and put clothes on has done both of the things the phrase's two words name
wearing one's finest clothes, as for a party or a formal occasion

explanation.surface: A playful remark about getting up and dressing, then appearing in one's finest outfit.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means wearing smart clothes; split into its words it also means clothed and out of bed.

clue.text: Such a one runs people hard:

definitions.text: Such a one runs people hard:

parts.words: Such a one runs people hard
parts.note: a tyrannical ruler governs a nation harshly, 'runs' meaning governs rather than sprints

explanation.surface: Someone who drives others hard, like a tough coach or a demanding boss.
explanation.definitionFit: A tyrant rules his subjects with absolute and oppressive power.

clue.text: We all know who's got offices from these

definitions.text: We all know who's got offices from these

parts.words: We all know who's got offices from these
parts.note: after a vote is counted, the public learns which candidates have won their public posts

explanation.surface: A remark about knowing who gets which office, as if handing out workspaces.
explanation.definitionFit: Announced outcomes of a poll tell everyone which candidates have won public posts.

clue.text: They try old needlework

definitions.meaning: people who taste or test things to sample them
embroidered cloth pieces showing stitches and letters, made by girls in former centuries

explanation.surface: Something about people attempting traditional embroidery.
explanation.definitionFit: Tasters test things; an embroidered panel of stitch examples was traditional needlework.

clue.text: Being outspoken show the way

definitions.meaning: frank and straightforward in speech
to guide or point someone towards a place

explanation.surface: A frank person guiding others along.
explanation.definitionFit: Straightforward speech is plain-spoken; to guide someone is to point them along a route.

clue.text: For something different to explore, he leaves the surface of the earth!

definitions.text: For something different to explore, he leaves the surface of the earth!

parts.words: For something different to explore, he leaves the surface of the earth
parts.note: a caver goes underground into caves rather than flying off into space, as the surface suggests

explanation.surface: An adventurer leaving Earth's surface for a new frontier, like an astronaut.
explanation.definitionFit: A caver explores underground passages, going below the ground rather than above it.

clue.text: Set the speed for a runner: walked along

definitions.text: Set the speed for a runner
definitions.meaning: a pacemaker in a race fixed the rate for another athlete
strode steadily, measuring out steps

explanation.surface: A pacemaker in a race, then someone strolling.
explanation.definitionFit: Leading a race sets its tempo; striding up and down is walking with measured steps.

clue.text: Bits of church pies are minced

indicators.note: mincing chops things up, so the letters are chopped and rearranged

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Fragments of church-fete pies chopped up small.
explanation.definitionFit: Fragments or parts of something are portions of it.

clue.text: Quite lost his head after being beaten by his own folk

definitions.text: Quite lost his head after being beaten by his own folk

parts.words: Quite lost his head after being beaten by his own folk
parts.note: the English king was defeated by Parliament's armies in the Civil War and then beheaded

explanation.surface: Someone who completely lost their temper after a defeat by relatives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lost his head' suggests losing one's temper but means literal beheading: the English king was executed in 1649 after losing the Civil War to his own subjects.
explanation.definitionFit: The Stuart monarch was beheaded in 1649 after defeat by Parliament in the English Civil War.

clue.text: Fancied a sleep, we hear!

definitions.meaning: imagined or wished for
what one reports having done during a night's slumber, visions that one tells others about

explanation.surface: Someone who fancied a nap, so people say.
explanation.definitionFit: Imagining something is fancying it; visions come during slumber.

clue.text: Goes over the water on vapour

definitions.text: Goes over the water on vapour

parts.words: Goes over the water on vapour
parts.note: a ship powered by steam crosses the sea

explanation.surface: Something travelling across water on a cushion of mist.
explanation.definitionFit: A steamship crosses water driven by steam power.

clue.text: Lacking right, generate strange time of youth

indicators.note: strange means the remaining letters are put into an odd new order
lacking means the letter for right is missing from the word generate

explanation.surface: Something without righteousness producing a peculiar period of youth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lacking' takes R from GENERATE, leaving GENEATE, which 'strange' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: The years from thirteen to nineteen are the period of being young.

clue.text: Shut by the cathedral

definitions.meaning: ..., as a door
the precinct around a cathedral, and 'by' meaning near

explanation.surface: Something shut near the cathedral.
explanation.definitionFit: Closing something shuts it; a cathedral's precinct is its enclosure.

clue.text: Ride around explosive old weapon

indicators.note: around marks the explosive's letters placed about the word ride, one set enclosing the other

explanation.surface: Riding around with explosives and an old weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: A three-pronged spear was an ancient weapon, carried by Neptune and gladiators.

clue.text: May be for reading in bed!

definitions.text: May be for reading in bed!

parts.words: May be for reading in bed
parts.note: a newspaper page is read, and a linen covering is on a bed

explanation.surface: A suggestion of something to read in bed.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a newspaper page and a bed linen covering.

clue.text: Bird sanctuaries may contain machine-guns

definitions.meaning: homes built by birds for their eggs and young
military emplacements holding guns, as in machine-gun posts

explanation.surface: Bird reserves concealing weapons.
explanation.definitionFit: Birds build homes for breeding; a fortified gun position takes the same name.

clue.text: Tried very hard to get filtered

definitions.meaning: made a great effort
passed through a sieve

explanation.surface: Someone straining every effort to be filtered.
explanation.definitionFit: Making a great effort is exerting oneself; sieving a liquid filters it.

clue.text: Left the other way

parts.note: the opposite direction to left, not departing by another route

explanation.surface: Someone who departed by another route.
explanation.definitionFit: The opposite direction to left is its counterpart side.

clue.text: Looking after drug, gain new position

indicators.note: the letters of the words drug and gain are put into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Caring for someone while a drug gains a new role.
explanation.definitionFit: Protecting someone means watching over them.

clue.text: Looks for some Indians, by the sound of it

indicators.note: signals that the word for these Indians is said aloud to give a different spelling

parts.note: Sikhs are followers of a religion from the Punjab in India

explanation.surface: Searching for some people from India, apparently.
explanation.definitionFit: Searching for something is hunting it out.

clue.text: Beastly place-but standing firm

definitions.meaning: a building where horses or cattle are housed
steady and secure

explanation.surface: A nasty place that nevertheless stands firm.
explanation.definitionFit: Horses are housed in a stall building; steady and secure things stand firm.

clue.text: Set his rod in low lying capitals, sounding high

indicators.note: capitals here are the initial letters of each of the six words before them

explanation.surface: An angler setting a rod in low-lying cities and making a piercing sound.
explanation.definitionFit: A piercing, high-pitched sound is described this way.

clue.text: Big game hunters, in the main

definitions.text: Big game hunters, in the main

parts.words: Big game hunters, in the main
parts.note: people hunting huge sea creatures in the ocean, 'the main' meaning the sea

explanation.surface: Big game hunters, generally speaking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In the main' looks like 'mostly' but is the old word for the open sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Sailors who hunt the largest sea mammals are pursuing the biggest game of all.

clue.text: Eel was writhing round another creature

indicators.note: writhing means twisting about, so the letters of eel was are twisted into a new order

explanation.surface: An eel thrashing around another animal.
explanation.definitionFit: A small carnivorous mammal is a creature like the eel mentioned.

clue.text: Mean to be so dirty, as it were

definitions.meaning: base and contemptible
filthy and squalid, the phrase roughly echoing the word itself

explanation.surface: Someone stingy enough to be very grubby.
explanation.definitionFit: Squalid, base behaviour is contemptible; filthy conditions are squalid.

clue.text: With an effort, get a lift:

definitions.text: With an effort, get a lift:

parts.words: With an effort, get a lift
parts.note: to raise something by a great pull, not to hitch a ride

explanation.surface: Struggling to hitch a ride.
explanation.definitionFit: Hauling something up with great effort is hoisting it.

clue.text: It's very valuable this farm beast, with one on

parts.note: a bull is a male farm animal
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A prize farm bull worth a great deal.
explanation.definitionFit: Gold or silver in bars is precious metal of great worth.

clue.text: Excited — by a spoon?

definitions.meaning: roused or agitated
mixed round with a spoon, as tea is

explanation.surface: Someone excited by a spoon.
explanation.definitionFit: Roused emotions are agitated; mixing tea with a spoon agitates it.

clue.text: Lease out help for the artist

indicators.note: out signals the letters of lease are put out of their order

explanation.surface: Renting out something useful to a painter.
explanation.definitionFit: A painter's stand holds the canvas, an aid to the work.

clue.text: Very pleased, having legal document about illumination

indicators.note: about means the document's letters go round the word for illumination

parts.note: a deed is a legal document

explanation.surface: Thrilled with a legal document about lighting.
explanation.definitionFit: Being thrilled is being greatly pleased.
